h1: Labs Cannabis in Pattaya — the shop behind the LABS DISPENSARY listing
intro: Labs Cannabis, formerly Labs Dispensary, is a licensed cannabis shop at 32 Pattaya 13 Alley in South Pattaya. On Google Maps the same place is listed as LABS DISPENSARY, which is why two names lead to one door. Flower is handed over in the shop, to adults aged 20 or older who hold a prescription issued in Thailand. This page explains where the shop stands and how a visit works; it publishes no menu and no numbers.

sections.body: The address is 32 Pattaya 13 Alley, South Pattaya, Chon Buri. {walkingStreet} — measured from the coordinates rather than promised in a slogan. Arriving by taxi or motorbike, name Pattaya 13 Alley rather than the shop, then look for the LABS DISPENSARY sign. The Google listing is the source of truth for the pin, and listing details can change, so open it before you set off.

Nothing is arranged on this website. You walk in, a member of staff asks what you are after, and the jars are opened so you can look and smell before deciding. Identification showing you are 20 or older and a prescription issued in Thailand are checked at the counter first. What sits in the jars changes with every harvest, so the answer to “what do you have today?” comes from a person on WhatsApp +66 66 080 6784, not from a page.

Since 26 June 2025 cannabis flower has been a controlled herb in Thailand. It is dispensed in person, in the shop, to adults aged 20 or older who present a prescription issued by a licensed practitioner in Thailand; such a prescription covers a course of up to 30 days. Prescriptions issued abroad are not accepted, and flower may not be taken out of the country.

faq.a: At 32 Pattaya 13 Alley in South Pattaya, Chon Buri. On Google Maps the same address is listed as LABS DISPENSARY. Open the live listing for the current pin and route.
The shop trades as Labs Cannabis and was previously Labs Dispensary; the Google listing still carries the older name. Both point to the same address and the same phone number.

faq.q: Do you sell vapes or e-cigarettes?
faq.a: No. Selling vapes and e-cigarettes is illegal in Thailand and we do not stock them. Labs Cannabis is a licensed cannabis dispensary.

closing: Open the LABS DISPENSARY listing on Google Maps for the pin and the route to 32 Pattaya 13 Alley, or ask on WhatsApp +66 66 080 6784 what is in the shop today. Adults 20+ with a prescription issued in Thailand.
